column1: # OpenChamber settings catalog consumed by install.sh and its test.
# Columns: key, value (value is the JSON literal the key holds)
# The installer merges these keys into ~/.config/openchamber/settings.json and
# leaves every other key untouched. That file is not linked or copied whole
# because it also holds relayEncryptionKey, relaySigningKey, security-scoped
# bookmarks, and per-machine session state, none of which may be tracked.
# $DOTFILES_ROOT in a value is replaced with the resolved checkout path. No
# other name expands, so every other $ stays literal.
# OpenCode CLI: the wrapper applies the OCX profile that a directly spawned
# binary would otherwise miss. See bin/opencode-profile.
# Appearance. The four splashBg/splashFg names the app writes are localStorage
# entries, not settings; desktopSplashColors is the key it owns in this file.
